loader_handoff.basis: The X-T4 2.12 loader passes its 0x5d0-byte boot-information block in r1 from 0x10aec; the kernel copies it to 0x82adc. The four flash setup words, ending with the NOR manufacturer byte 0x2c, match that copy in RAM read from a running X-T4 2.12. The cold boot reason and every other word stay synthetic.

power_checksum_registers.basis: Four-byte checksum frames: X-T4 2.12 clocks each power-controller frame as four bytes, most significant first (0x011d4388), a seven-bit register with a write flag, a data word and a checksum byte that brings the byte sum to 0xff (0x011d52fc builds a read). The loader reads the eight-byte settings profile header from registers 31..34 and stores it at boot-information offset 0x148; the board serves the requested profile header there. The settings writer stores registers 31..34 and 39 back, and startup writes 0x0100 to register 18, so these are stored words. Register 0 is 0xb8b7, the startup sample the firmware kept in RAM of a running X-T4 2.12; startup (0x01291324) continues the boot only with bit 0x400 clear when the boot reason is 4. Registers 2, 14, 17, 29, 30, 39 and 67 are the last values in the firmware's power-register cache in RAM of that camera, read in USB service mode. Registers 35 (low) and 36 (high) are a seconds-since-2000 clock, declared stopped at zero. Physical values at power-on are not measured.

geometry.basis: 128 KiB erase sectors and 256-byte pages of the MT35XU512ABA; erase and page timing are declared virtual inputs.

serial_flash.basis: The X-T4 NOR is a Micron MT35XU512ABA, 64 MiB, JEDEC ID 2c 5b 1a; erase and page timing are declared virtual inputs.
